label: PaySim mobile-money benchmark

split.strategy: Time-based 70 / 15 / 15 split by step. Training down-samples genuine transactions to 200,000 plus every training fraud; validation and test keep the full population prevalence.

excluded: step (used only for the time split)

logistic.name: Logistic regression
logistic.note: Post-transaction balance fields are included; this is post-transaction screening, not prevention.

forest.name: Random forest (ranger)
forest.note: 200 trees, minimum node size 10, class-weighted; threshold tuned on validation only.

limitations: Metrics describe this benchmark's held-out test split, not real-world fraud detection.
The test set is kept at its original prevalence; it is never balanced to improve the reported numbers.
A threshold tuned on validation maximises F1 and is then frozen for the test evaluation.
Identifiers and outcome-derived fields are excluded from the predictors.
PaySim is a synthetic generator; near-perfect separation reflects its balance mechanics and post-transaction fields, not real-world fraud skill.
Row counts across the time split differ because transaction volume varies sharply by step.
